dedupe_keys.name: aguaclara water treatment design and process package

description: aguaclara is a Python package from AguaClara Cornell and AguaClara Reach for designing and studying drinking-water treatment plants. Its documented modules calculate hydraulic and chemical properties, size coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation and filtration components, prepare experiments and analyse process-control data. Users supply flow, treatment-chemical, temperature and plant-component assumptions; outputs are design dimensions and process estimates for the selected facility. Geography and operating period follow the user-defined plant or experiment, not a bundled national network. The MIT-licensed source and PyPI distribution are free, with API examples and component calculations. The README says the package is developing rapidly and the full user guide is pending, so examples may not cover all design choices. The package does not replace detailed local water-quality tests or engineering approval. It can support treatment capacity and process-operation simulations. The catalogue's model-epanet represents distribution hydraulics downstream from a treatment plant; no interface between them was tested. No treatment dataset or package was downloaded.
